title: Unused Commitment Fee on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
An Operating Lines of Credit product whose unused commitment fee is above zero is charged that fee for each calendar quarter, and for the stub quarter ending on the maturity date.

## Rule

1. **Period and date.** The fee is assessed on the day after the quarter ends, with the period's first and last days set to the days covered.
2. **Amount.** The fee is the product's unused commitment fee, as a percentage a year, applied to the commitment in force on the last day of the period less the average daily outstanding principal of the period, for the days of the period over 365, rounded to cents. The average daily outstanding principal is the total of each day's end-of-day principal over the period divided by the number of calendar days in the period, first and last days included.
3. **No fee.** A period in which average principal is at or above the commitment carries no fee, and no fee is charged for any period after the line is closed. Products whose unused commitment fee is zero are never charged.

## Worked period (hypothetical Revolving Operating Line, 0.10% a year)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Quarter covered | 1 July to 30 September, 92 days |
| Commitment in force on 30 September | USD 1,000,000 |
| Total of daily end-of-day principal | USD 46,000,000 |
| Average daily outstanding principal | USD 46,000,000 divided by 92, that is USD 500,000 |
| Unused amount | USD 1,000,000 less USD 500,000, that is USD 500,000 |
| Fee | USD 500,000 multiplied by 0.10%, multiplied by 92 and divided by 365, that is USD 126.027…, rounded to USD 126.03 |
| Assessed on | 1 October |

## Points of judgement

- If the average daily principal of the same quarter had been USD 1,000,000 or more, no fee would be charged for it.
- A StartRight Operating Line, an ExpressLine Operating Credit or a Seasonal Operating Loan is never charged this fee, its unused commitment fee being zero.
